_readme: Source of truth for the works the gallery can hang. Edit here, then run `python3 scripts/build-catalogue.py`, which measures each image and writes assets/gallery/catalogue.js. `id` is permanent: shared exhibition links are made of ids, so never reuse or rename one. family: matter = HrM paint and mixed media; signal = HrM digital images; archive = public-domain material collected by HrM. frame: canvas = gallery-wrapped edge, frame = thin black frame, mat = oak frame with a window mat.

works.title: Cadavre Expat I
works.note: The first recovered Cadavre Expat collage opens the sequence: a body assembled from displacement, fracture and stubborn continuity.

works.title: Cadavre Expat II
works.note: Dense material and a squared field turn the second work into the sequence’s compressed, resistant centre.

works.title: Cadavre Expat III
works.note: Fading impressions and reclaimed support make the third collage read as an image surviving its own erasure.

works.title: Cadavre Expat IV
works.medium: Reclaimed cardboard, oil, acrylic, glue and digital echo
works.note: The final work expands the recovered fragments into a wide closing image, holding physical residue against its digital echo.

works.title: Untitled 12
works.note: A dark head surfaces through a crust of rust, spiral stencils and scattered red.

works.title: Untitled 13
works.note: A sun-burst stencil and a faint figure dissolve into a terracotta field.

works.title: Untitled 14
works.note: A blue, childlike face is scrawled over corroded vertical bands.

works.title: Untitled 15
works.note: Mesh, chevrons and a traffic light collide in a crowded, layered surface.

works.title: Untitled 16
works.note: A bruised blue sky presses down on a frieze of small coral silhouettes.

works.title: Untitled 17
works.note: Two red blooms on long stems drift across a grey, wind-scraped ground.

works.title: Untitled 18
works.note: The paired red blooms return, closer and louder, against a pale blue weather.

works.title: Untitled 19
works.note: A weathered earthen field opens around a fractured face, with exposed mesh and radiating scraped passages.

works.title: Untitled Arcs
works.note: Bands of rust, blue and bone sweep across the surface like the inside of a turning wheel.

works.title: Unfinished Arc Study I
works.note: A square study of curving, multicoloured bands — the arc as a gesture still in progress.

works.title: Unfinished Arc Study II
works.note: The companion study: red and white bands cut hard through a darker ground.

works.title: Untitled
works.note: A stick figure points out of a blazing yellow and orange vortex.

works.title: Mixed Media II
works.note: A radiant landscape organised around a single stencilled sun.

works.title: Mixed Media III
works.note: Faces, a red figure and patched grey ground in a textural, collaged landscape.

works.title: Mixed Media IV
works.note: A vertical figure in a field of hot orange, ringed by targets and loose marks.

works.title: Untitled 01
works.note: A large poster-like image behind chain-link geometry: stacked SHINE lettering above an upraised hand.

works.title: Untitled 02
works.note: A figure drops through a radiant field with a moon overhead and a white burst across the centre.

works.title: Untitled 03
works.note: A furious emoji and fractured figures suspended in a dense glitch architecture.

works.title: Untitled 04
works.note: A heroic worker-figure rendered in pale linework and halo-like light over a faded Americana backdrop.

works.title: Untitled 06
works.note: A nocturnal Chartres vision with rose window, stained glass and a solitary figure facing the horizon.

works.title: Untitled 07
works.note: A framed neon chain-link composition built around stacked SHINE lettering and an upraised hand.

works.title: Untitled 08
works.note: A blunt graphic poster with cartoon figures and a self-accusing slogan, comic and uneasy at once.

works.title: Untitled 09
works.note: Another state of the SHINE fence, in green and pink, the raised hand still pressing up from below.

works.title: Untitled 10
works.note: A frontal horned figure in a suit over cracked, molten ground — absurdly official and infernal.

works.title: Untitled 11
works.note: A grey political crowd, and one bright pink figure in the foreground who will not come into focus.

works.title: Bull Guy
works.note: A bull in a business suit, front-on against a clean blue sky.

works.title: Chartres Light
works.note: The rose and lancets of Chartres rebuilt as a tall column of coloured light.

works.title: Artford Circus
works.note: A towering poster-wall of logos, tags and ringmasters, with the suited audience seated beneath it.

works.title: Goalgotha
works.note: A night column of stars, graffiti and a lone walker, with a hovering craft at the summit.

works.title: Untitled (Hands)
works.note: Two hands reach across a pale, cracked surface without quite meeting.

works.title: Untitled (Clown)
works.note: A striped clown stands beside a framed picture inside a picture, watched from below.

works.title: Untitled (Pink City)
works.note: A skyline dissolves in a magenta haze beneath a ringed, burning sun.

works.title: Untitled (Clock Minotaur)
works.note: A horned figure enthroned in black, a clock where the heart should be.

works.title: Bizzarie, plate I

works.title: Bizzarie, plate II
works.note: A winged device and two statues beside an easel.

works.title: Bizzarie, plate III
works.note: An armoured pair, assembled from plates and hinges, gesturing across empty ground.

works.title: Bizzarie, plate IV
works.note: Two skeletal figures stride through one another.

works.title: Bizzarie, plate VII
works.note: Figures made of buckets and bowls.

works.title: Bizzarie, plate VIII
works.note: A rectilinear pair, all boxes and right angles.

works.title: Bizzarie, plate IX
works.note: A flame-bodied pair.

works.title: Bizzarie, plate XII
works.note: A harlequin pair.

works.title: Another Decapitation

works.note: From a manual of stage illusions: the trick performed.

works.title: Explanation of the Decapitation Trick
works.series: Magic: Stage Illusions and Scientific Diversions
works.note: …and the trick explained.

works.title: The Apparition
works.series: Magic: Stage Illusions and Scientific Diversions
works.note: A seated skeleton appears to a man at his desk.

works.title: Sword Blade in the Body
works.series: Magic: Stage Illusions and Scientific Diversions
works.note: A blade passes through a body that does not object.

works.title: The Subject and His Skeleton
works.series: Magic: Stage Illusions and Scientific Diversions
works.note: A man and his own skeleton, side by side on stage.

works.title: Desire Retained · Desire Released
works.note: Two heads in profile, wired with arrows: what is held in, and what gets out.

works.title: Häxan
works.note: A firelit gathering from Benjamin Christensen’s film about witchcraft.

works.title: The Temple of Time
works.note: History drawn as a colonnaded hall receding to a vanishing point.

works.title: Head of Figures
works.note: A profile head composed entirely of contorted bodies.

works.title: Hieroglyphics of the Trades I
works.medium: Hand-coloured print, S. W. Fores, Piccadilly
works.note: Tradesmen assembled from the tools of their trades.

works.title: Hieroglyphics of the Trades II
works.medium: Hand-coloured print, S. W. Fores, Piccadilly
works.note: More trades, more people made of their work.

works.title: Septentrionalium Terrarum
works.note: The North Pole as a ring of four imagined islands around a black rock.

works.title: Wall Map of Japan
works.note: Japan’s provinces in pastel blocks, mounted as a wall map.

works.title: Mars
works.note: The canals of Mars, drawn with total conviction.

works.title: Mountains and Rivers of the World
works.note: Every great mountain lined up, every river laid side by side.

works.title: Manhattan
works.note: A city recorded block by block in the colours of what it is built from.

works.title: Ancient Courses of the Mississippi
works.note: Centuries of a wandering river, drawn over one another in ribbons of colour.

works.title: Coastal Chart
works.note: A coast described by soundings and the shapes of hills seen from the sea.

works.title: Coast Survey
works.note: A shoreline surveyed to the edge of the known.
